details:
Allow a potential mod creator a way to post their mod ideas to VRChat, and community members to vote on them for implementation. 
If a potential mod is given the go ahead, allow the mod creator to make a plugin for it, which the VRChat team can curate and approve, before bringing the plugin into the client. Significantly reduces developer workload on the features the community wants, while still giving the developers all the control of what does and does not make it onto the platform. Heck, perhaps even VRChat purchasing the rights to the plugin from the creator, if it's approved by the development and security teams.
Allowing unfettered mod usage is a very real problem, but so too is taking away so many features that so many have come to rely on. VRChat started with donations and crowdfunding in the first place, let the community help to develop it too.
title: Crowdsourced mod voting
